items.headline: Memphis' Charles Huff says he's not candidate for Maryland head coaching job
items.description: Memphis' Charles Huff said he's not a candidate for the head coaching vacancy at Maryland and will not be part of this year's coaching carousel.

items.headline: No Big Ten football teams in AP top 5 for first time since 2021
items.description: A weekend of Big Ten upsets left the conference without a team in the top five of the AP Top 25 college football poll for the first time since 2021.

items.headline: Navy scores with 15 seconds left, knocks off No. 24 Memphis 38-34 to shake up American Conf. race
items.description: — Vic Listorti ran for a 6-yard touchdown on fourth down with 15 seconds remaining, and Navy shook up the American Conference title race with a 38-34 win over No. 24 Memphis on Saturday.
